Pattern objects

Source: R/zz-gen-shared.R
go_pattern.Rd

Sets the pattern within the marker. Used for pattern, fillpattern in 9 places in the schema. go_pattern() creates one; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_pattern(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  bgcolor = NULL,
  fgcolor = NULL,
  fgopacity = NULL,
  fillmode = NULL,
  path = NULL,
  shape = NULL,
  size = NULL,
  solidity = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from. Named arguments take precedence.

...

Not used: properties must be named in full.

bgcolor

When there is no colorscale sets the color of background pattern fill. Defaults to a `marker.color` background when `fillmode` is "overlay". Otherwise, defaults to a transparent background. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

fgcolor

When there is no colorscale sets the color of foreground pattern fill. Defaults to a `marker.color` background when `fillmode` is "replace". Otherwise, defaults to dark grey or white to increase contrast with the `bgcolor`. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

fgopacity

Sets the opacity of the foreground pattern fill. Defaults to a 0.5 when `fillmode` is "overlay". Otherwise, defaults to 1. Number in the interval [0, 1].

fillmode

Determines whether `marker.color` should be used as a default to `bgcolor` or a `fgcolor`. One of "replace", "overlay".

path

Sets a custom path for pattern fill. Use with no `shape` or `solidity`, provide an SVG path string for the regions of the square from (0,0) to (`size`,`size`) to color. String, or a vector of these.

shape

Sets the shape of the pattern fill. By default, no pattern is used for filling the area. One of "", "/", "\\", "x", "-", "|", "+", ".", or a vector of these.

size

Sets the size of unit squares of the pattern fill in pixels, which corresponds to the interval of repetition of the pattern. Number in the interval [0, Inf], or a vector of these.

solidity

Sets the solidity of the pattern fill. Solidity is roughly the fraction of the area filled by the pattern. Solidity of 0 shows only the background color without pattern and solidty of 1 shows only the foreground color without pattern. Number in the interval [0, 1], or a vector of these.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_pattern object (a named list).

Details

These objects appear in 9 places in the plotly.js schema (properties named pattern, fillpattern), all with the same properties and rules.

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~wt,
    y = ~mpg,
    mode = "markers",
    fillpattern = go_pattern(size = 10)
  )
